module_decomposition.strategy: Extract bounded modules from the 2340-line monolith into ES6 module files co-located under assets/sticker-configurator/. Each module is a plain ES6 class (not a custom element) that receives the core component reference via constructor injection, communicating via method calls and CustomEvents. The core StickerConfigurator class orchestrates module composition in its init().

modules.name: StickerConfigurator
responsibilities: Web Component lifecycle (constructor, connectedCallback, disconnectedCallback, attributeChangedCallback)
init() — gather DOM refs, set CANVAS_W/CANVAS_H, compose submodules, kickstart state
State object ownership (items, selectedIds, history, zoom, pan, etc.)
Property bridge: expose dataset attributes (section-id, heading, subtext, bg-color) as typed JS properties
Module composition: instantiate all submodules, pass this reference
anti_patterns_fixed: Monolithic init() → delegated to submodules

modules.name: CanvasRenderer
responsibilities: drawGrid() — DPR-aware canvas grid rendering, configurable cell size
renderToCanvas() — offscreen canvas rendering for PDF export
growCanvas() — expand wrap/canvas height on overflow (NEVER shrink)
anti_patterns_fixed: Grid logic extracted from monolith
Magic numbers (0.5 lineWidth, '#E8E8E8') → CSS variable / config

modules.name: ItemManager
responsibilities: addImageItem(src, silent) — create image .canvas-item DOM element
addTextItem(text, fontSize, silent, color, bgColor, fontWeight, fontStyle, textAlign) — create text .canvas-item DOM element
addItemHelpers(el, id) — create item data object, push to state.items
deleteSelected() — remove items from DOM and state
_createItemElement(type, id) — factory for item DOM structure (handles, size-info, WCAG attrs)
anti_patterns_fixed: Duplicate DOM creation code in addImageItem/addTextItem → _createItemElement factory
Repeated el.style.* assignments → centralized applyItemStyles(item)
Copy-paste in duplicateSelected/restoreState/pasteClipboard → reusable _cloneItemProps()

modules.name: InteractionManager
responsibilities: onMouseMove(e) — delegate to active dragState type
onMouseUp(e) — save state, clear guides, validate overlaps
onTouchMove(e) — drag/resize/pinch-zoom with 20px scroll threshold, 2px jitter filter
startResize(e, id, handle) — init resize state
_applyDragMove(ds, dx, dy) — shared move logic for mouse+touch
anti_patterns_fixed: Duplicated push-apart logic in onMouseMove + onTouchMove → extract to CollisionEngine
var self = this / .bind(this) inconsistency → arrow functions or lexical this
DOM queries in hot path (querySelector in mousemove) → cache refs in constructor
var → const/let throughout
Magic numbers (0.1 zoomStep, 30 minSize, 2px jitter, 20px scrollThreshold, 1.5 scrollRatio, 5 push-iterations) → module constants

modules.name: SelectionManager
responsibilities: selectAllInRect(x1, y1, x2, y2) — drag-select rect intersection
updateSelection() — update DOM classes, toolbar button states, size inputs
updateGuides(item, items) — alignment snap guide lines (5px threshold)
anti_patterns_fixed: DOM querySelectors in updateSelection → cached refs
Guide line hardcoded colors → config reference

modules.name: HistoryManager
responsibilities: saveState() — serialize all items to compact snapshot, push to history stack
restoreState(snapshot) — tear down current items, rebuild from snapshot
anti_patterns_fixed: Mixed async image loading in restoreState → Promise-based sequencing

modules.name: AlignmentEngine
responsibilities: onAlignClick(dir) — 6-direction alignment (left, h, right, top, v, bot)
onAutoArrange() — brick-laying by descending area, configurable gap in mm
anti_patterns_fixed: Math.min.apply(null, ...) → Math.min(...spread)
Direct DOM mutation interleaved with state logic → separate concerns

modules.name: MobileHandler
responsibilities: onMobileToggle() — toggle .mobile-mode class, swap wrap/canvas heights
Mobile-mode rules: section position:static, wrap overflow:auto, canvas height NEVER cleared
Desktop-mode restore: re-apply wrap/canvas height = CANVAS_H
anti_patterns_fixed: onMobileToggle does inline SVG for mobile button icon → extract to helper or template
setTimeout(zoomToFit, 100) → clearer debounce/transition-end approach

modules.name: ModalManager
responsibilities: showAddDesignModal() — file picker modal with size/copies
showEditTextModal(item, callback) — rich text editing modal (content, font size, color, bg, bold, italic, alignment)
createModal(htmlStructure) — create DOM modal element with role='dialog', aria-modal='true'
Close handlers: backdrop click, Escape key, close button
anti_patterns_fixed: innerHTML construction → document.createElement for dynamic content (XSS prevention) or template literal with escaping
Inline event handlers in HTML strings → programmatic binding
Hardcoded string labels → locale reference or schema-driven

modules.name: ExportManager
responsibilities: onExportPDF() — dynamic import('jspdf') or script injection fallback
renderPDF() — create jsPDF document, delegate to CanvasRenderer.renderToCanvas(), embed image
anti_patterns_fixed: Script tag injection → dynamic import('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/...) or import('jspdf')
Unchecked window.jspdf global → proper import/load check

modules.name: KeyboardManager
anti_patterns_fixed: Ctrl+Y redo + Ctrl+Shift+Z redo both call redo() → consolidated
Paste logic inline → delegate to ClipboardManager

modules.name: ClipboardManager
responsibilities: copy() — serialize selected items to this.state.clipboard
paste() — reconstruct items from clipboard data with offset
_serializeItem(item) — compact serialization (src as reference, not data URL)
anti_patterns_fixed: Clipboard stores full data URLs → store reference strings or serialize without binary bloat
Inline copy/paste in onKeyDown → delegated to manager

modules.name: CollisionEngine
anti_patterns_fixed: 30-line duplicated push-apart code in mouse + touch handlers → single CollisionEngine.resolveOverlaps()

modules.name: SnapEngine
responsibilities: snapVal(v, gridSize) — round to nearest grid increment
applySnap(item, items) — snap during drag end
Grid size configurable via bottom bar input (5-100px, default 20px)
anti_patterns_fixed: snapVal() existed but was NEVER called → integrate into InteractionManager drag end
Snap checkbox handler was a no-op → wire it correctly

modules.name: PriceManager
responsibilities: updatePrice() — calculate price = basePrice × itemCount × quantity
anti_patterns_fixed: Hardcoded base price $2.5 → configurable via schema setting or metafield

modules.name: Utils
responsibilities: updateSizeInfo(item) — display size label on item
updateSizeInputs() — sync W/H inputs with selection

web_component_spec.dom_strategy: Light DOM — no Shadow DOM (Shopify Horizon compatibility)

lifecycle.connectedCallback(): requestAnimationFrame(() => this.init()) — defer to ensure DOM ready

composition.pattern: Constructor injection — StickerConfigurator creates all submodule instances, passing `this` as core reference.

data_flow.topology: Centralized state (this.state) with submodule access via core reference. Submodules read/write state directly. Cross-cutting concerns (history saves, UI updates) triggered by the core orchestrator after mutations.

flow_diagram.user_interaction: User input (click/touch/keyboard) → InteractionManager.on*() → state mutation → historyManager.saveState() → canvasRenderer.drawGrid()/growCanvas() → selectionManager.updateSelection() → priceManager.updatePrice() → CustomEvent dispatch
flow_diagram.item_addition: ModalManager (file picker) → ItemManager.addImageItem() → state.items.push → findNextSlot → DOM append → growCanvas → saveState → updateSelection → dispatchUpdateEvent
flow_diagram.undo_redo: Keyboard/button → HistoryManager.undo() → restoreState (teardown + rebuild items) → growCanvas → updateSelection → updateCount → updatePrice → dispatchUpdateEvent
flow_diagram.export: Button click → ExportManager.onExportPDF() → dynamic import jsPDF → CanvasRenderer.renderToCanvas() → embed in PDF → document.save()
flow_diagram.mobile_toggle: Button / autoDetect → MobileHandler.onMobileToggle() → toggle .mobile-mode class → swap heights → zoomToFit

data_flow.inter_module_communication: Direct method calls (not CustomEvents within the component). CustomEvents only for external listeners (theme.js, analytics, add-to-cart).
data_flow.design_pattern: Orchestrator pattern: StickerConfigurator (core) orchestrates submodules. Submodules do NOT call each other directly — they mutate state and the core triggers cascading updates via a single _afterMutation() hook.

violations_audit.summary: The current codebase has 22 identified anti-patterns across JS, CSS, and Liquid. No Turkish found in code. No !important found in CSS. No browser dialogs found.

high.description: Monolithic single class (2340 lines). Every feature lives on one class. No module separation.
high.fix: Decompose into 15 bounded modules per decomposition plan.

high.description: Push-apart collision logic duplicated verbatim (~30 lines) in onMouseMove (lines 992-1013) and onTouchMove (lines 1233-1254).
snapVal() method (line 2265) is defined but NEVER CALLED anywhere in the codebase. Snap-to-grid feature is non-functional.
high.fix: Integrate snapVal() calls in InteractionManager drag end (onMouseUp, onTouchEnd).

high.description: Snap checkbox handler (line 253-255) is a no-op: 'function () { this.checked = this.checked; }' — does NOT update this.state.snapEnabled.

medium.description: Mixed use of 'var', 'let', 'const'. Predominantly 'var' (ES5 style) throughout 2340 lines.
medium.fix: Replace var with const for references, let for mutables.

medium.description: Inconsistent this binding: mixes 'var self = this' (lines 391, 511, 610), '.bind(this)' (line 1756), and arrow functions (line 914, 1085).
medium.fix: Use lexical arrow functions consistently. Remove self pattern.

medium.description: this.querySelector() called repeatedly in mouse/touch move hot paths (onMouseMove, onTouchMove, onMouseUp).
medium.fix: Cache DOM references during init() for all commonly-queried elements.

medium.description: showEditTextModal uses innerHTML with user text interpolated (line 1862: curText.replace). Potential XSS vector.
medium.fix: Use document.createElement + textContent for dynamic content, or escape HTML entities.

medium.description: DOM element creation logic for items duplicated across addImageItem (lines 571-636) and addTextItem (lines 643-721): handles, rot-handle, size-info, WCAG attributes all repeated.
medium.fix: Extract to _createItemElement(type, id) factory method in ItemManager.

medium.description: restoreState() duplicates item reconstruction logic already in addImageItem/addTextItem (lines 397-451). Uses fragile onload pattern.
medium.fix: Reuse ItemManager methods with silent=true flag. Use Promise.all for async image loading.

medium.description: jsPDF loaded via script tag injection into document.body (line 1769-1775). Loads even if export not intended.
medium.fix: Use dynamic import() or module script with async loading. Only load on actual export click.

medium.description: Clipboard stores raw data URLs in clipboard.src (line 1374). Can be very large. Not serializable for localStorage or form submission.
medium.fix: Store image reference (name, data) or use IndexedDB/blob URL. For cart submission, serialize as base64 limited to canvas state.

low.description: Multiple magic numbers throughout: 0.15 (default item size ratio), 0.75 (aspect), 20 (grow buffer, duplicate offset), 5 (push iterations, snap threshold), 0.1 (zoom step), 30 (min resize px), 2 (jitter threshold), 0.6 (text width calc), 1.8 (text height ratio), 2.5 (base price).
low.fix: Define as module-level constants or config with descriptive names.

low.description: Hardcoded colors in JS: '#00CEC9' and '#6C5CE7' in updateGuides(), '#2D3436' and '#FF4444' in overlap detection.
low.fix: Reference CSS variables via getComputedStyle or define as constants.

low.description: updateCanvasWH() is an empty stub (line 352-354) — called in zoom/drag hot paths. Dead code path.
low.fix: Either implement or remove calls. Currently wastes function call overhead in hot path.

low.description: Distribute horizontal/vertical not implemented. Feature 12 in PRD mentions it but no code exists.
low.fix: Add distributeHorizontal() and distributeVertical() methods to AlignmentEngine.

low.description: No .focus-visible CSS styles defined. Some modals use aria but keyboard navigation focus indicators may be missing.
low.fix: Add :focus-visible styles for all interactive elements.

low.description: Hardcoded hex colors where CSS vars should be used: rgba(0, 206, 201, 0.27) in .canvas-item:hover, rgba(0, 206, 201, 0.08) in .sel-box.
#B2BEC3 hardcoded in multiple places (size-inputs label, zoom-display, cfg-text-muted, modal row span).
prefers-reduced-motion uses !important (line 706-707). Only !important in the codebase.
low.fix: Increase specificity instead of !important. E.g., html.sticker-configurator .sticker-configurator *.

low.description: Toolbar buttons use individual id attributes (e.g., id="undo-btn-{{ section.id }}") instead of data attributes or class-based delegation.
low.fix: Use data-action attributes for delegation (e.g., data-action="undo"). JS can use event delegation on .toolbar instead of per-button getElementById.

single_responsibility_principle.current_state: One class handles ALL responsibilities: lifecycle, DOM events, state, rendering, alignment, export, clipboard, price, history, mobile, modals, keyboard, collision, grid drawing, drag interaction.
single_responsibility_principle.target_state: Each module has one clear responsibility. StickerConfigurator orchestrates. 15 modules each own a bounded context. Each module < 350 lines.
assessment: CanvasRenderer: owns grid drawing, zoom/pan transform, renderToCanvas
ItemManager: owns item CRUD (create, read, update, delete)
InteractionManager: owns input event handling and drag state machine
HistoryManager: owns undo/redo and state serialization
AlignmentEngine: owns alignment, distribution, auto-arrange
CollisionEngine: owns push-apart overlap resolution
SnapEngine: owns snap-to-grid
ClipboardManager: owns copy/paste serialization
ExportManager: owns PDF export
ModalManager: owns modal lifecycle and focus trapping
PriceManager: owns price calculation and display
KeyboardManager: owns keyboard shortcut routing
MobileHandler: owns mobile mode detection and toggle
SelectionManager: owns multi-select and guide lines
Utils: owns conversion math and utility updates

open_closed_principle.current_state: New features require modifying StickerConfigurator class directly. The class is NOT open for extension.
open_closed_principle.target_state: Core files (sticker-configurator.js entry point) are closed for modification. New features add new modules (new files) without touching existing module logic.
assessment: Adding a new toolbar command: add button config entry + new method in appropriate module. No core changes.
Adding a new export format: new ExportManager method only.
Adding a new interaction: extend InteractionManager or add new interaction module.
Schema settings drive feature toggles (enable_clipboard, enable_export, etc.) — no code change needed to disable features.
CAVEAT: StickerConfigurator.compose() (init) needs updating to instantiate new modules — this is the single point of extension.

liskov_substitution_principle.current_state: Single class hierarchy. Not applicable since there's no inheritance tree.
liskov_substitution_principle.target_state: If subclasses of StickerConfigurator are ever created, they must preserve: init() contract, state shape, DOM structure expectations. All submodules depend on core interface (state, querySelector, CANVAS_W/H) — any substitute must provide these.
assessment: No inheritance currently — all items share CanvasItem interface through state object.
Image items and text items are substitutable through the CanvasItem type: both have {id, x, y, w, h, el, locked, rotation, scaleX, scaleY, src/text}.
All items respond to the same DOM and interaction logic.
LSP satisfied at data level.

interface_segregation_principle.current_state: Every method on the monolith has access to 'this' which includes ALL methods and ALL state. No interface boundaries.
interface_segregation_principle.target_state: Each module receives only what it needs via constructor injection. Modules interact through well-defined method contracts.
assessment: Submodule constructor receives 'this' (the Web Component) — this is intentionally broad for init-phase access.
BUT: submodules should NOT access each other directly. All cross-module coordination flows through the core StickerConfigurator.
No module relies on another module's internal implementation.
CustomEvent dispatch is the only external API surface.
DOM refs are cached per module during init, not searched globally.

dependency_inversion_principle.current_state: Components communicate via CustomEvents for external listeners (lines 2277-2334). Internal communication is direct method calls (tight coupling).
dependency_inversion_principle.target_state: External communication: CustomEvents on the host element. Internal communication: method calls through the core orchestrator (not direct module-to-module).
assessment: CustomEvent protocol already defined (lines 2277-2334): update, selection, price, add-to-cart, export events. ✓
No module depends on another module's concrete implementation — all go through StickerConfigurator core.
No external library dependencies except jsPDF (loaded dynamically). ✓
DOM queries use this.querySelector within the element scope, not document.querySelector. ✓
AbortController signal used for all event listeners — proper cleanup. ✓

distribute_feature_plan.status: MISSING — Feature 12 in PRD requires distribute horizontal/vertical but no code exists.

methods: distributeHorizontal() — evenly space selected items along X axis within bounds
distributeVertical() — evenly space selected items along Y axis within bounds

algorithm.distribute_h: Sort selected items by x. totalW = sum of item widths. available = (maxX - minX) — totalW. gap = available / (count — 1). Position items sequentially with computed gap.
algorithm.distribute_v: Sort selected items by y. Similar logic for vertical axis.
